propositions: LLM step failure tally must be surfaced at `coverage.llm_step_failures` in both code-review and completion verdicts, mirroring the plan-review implementation
review-code gate scope activation at gate_dispatch.py:480 must call `collect_step_failures()` alongside `collect_contract_violations()`
verify-completion gate scope activation at gate_dispatch.py:696 must call `collect_step_failures()` to cover the entire run_workflow call

completion_verdict must drain the step-failure tally in `completion_reconcile` before `validate_structured()`, with `coverage` object created only when tally is non-empty to preserve byte-identity on clean runs
Both verdict schemas must declare `coverage.llm_step_failures` with required subkeys `[total, by_step]` where `total` and `by_step` are integers with minimum 1
Step-failure tally observability must not alter any verdict content, exit code, signature, or provenance stamp, and must not appear when empty
